component.name: AnimProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.seq = 0 m.tick = 0
m.rectA = m.top.findNode("rectA") m.rectB = m.top.findNode("rectB") m.rectC = m.top.findNode("rectC") m.rectD = m.top.findNode("rectD") m.leafAnim = m.top.findNode("leafAnim") m.parAnim = m.top.findNode("parAnim") m.parChild1 = m.top.findNode("parChild1") m.parChild2 = m.top.findNode("parChild2") m.seqAnim = m.top.findNode("seqAnim") m.seqChild1 = m.top.findNode("seqChild1") m.seqChild2 = m.top.findNode("seqChild2") m.seqChild3 = m.top.findNode("seqChild3") m.delayAnim = m.top.findNode("delayAnim")
' The script is a flat list of steps: each entry is { at: <tick>, act: "<step-id>" }. ' Ticks are 0.25s apart, so `at` is quarter-seconds from the start of the run. m.script = [ ' --- L: leaf baseline. Does start write keyValue[0] before the next frame? --- { at: 1, act: "L_begin" } { at: 2, act: "L_mid" } { at: 10, act: "L_afterStop" }
' --- N: control="none" on a RUNNING animation. Reference: "no associated action". --- { at: 12, act: "N_start" } { at: 14, act: "N_writeNone" } { at: 16, act: "N_sample" } { at: 17, act: "N_cleanup" }
' --- PF: ParallelAnimation finish. Must set BOTH children's targets to final. --- { at: 19, act: "PF_start" } { at: 20, act: "PF_finish" } { at: 21, act: "PF_sample" } { at: 22, act: "PF_cleanup" }
' --- PP: ParallelAnimation pause -> do the children actually stop advancing? --- { at: 24, act: "PP_start" } { at: 25, act: "PP_pause" } { at: 26, act: "PP_sampleA" } { at: 30, act: "PP_sampleB" } { at: 31, act: "PP_resume" } { at: 32, act: "PP_sampleC" } { at: 36, act: "PP_cleanup" }
' --- SF: SequentialAnimation finish during child 1 -> are children 2 AND 3 final? --- { at: 38, act: "SF_start" } { at: 39, act: "SF_finish" } { at: 40, act: "SF_sample" } { at: 41, act: "SF_cleanup" }
' --- SP: SequentialAnimation pause/resume. --- { at: 43, act: "SP_start" } { at: 44, act: "SP_pause" } { at: 48, act: "SP_sample" } { at: 49, act: "SP_resume" } { at: 51, act: "SP_sampleAfter" } { at: 52, act: "SP_cleanup" }
' --- D: delay. Is the target snapped to keyValue[0] while the delay runs? --- { at: 54, act: "D_start" } { at: 55, act: "D_duringDelay" } { at: 59, act: "D_afterDelay" } { at: 62, act: "D_cleanup" }
{ at: 64, act: "FINISH" } ] m.scriptIndex = 0
p("all", "start", "steps=" + itos(m.script.count())) m.stepTimer = m.top.findNode("stepTimer") m.stepTimer.observeField("fire", "onStep") m.stepTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub onStep() m.tick = m.tick + 1 while m.scriptIndex < m.script.count() and m.script[m.scriptIndex].at <= m.tick runStep(m.script[m.scriptIndex].act) m.scriptIndex = m.scriptIndex + 1 end while end sub
sub runStep(id as string) if id = "L_begin" resetTargets() p("L-leaf", "before-start", snapshot(m.leafAnim, "leafAnim")) m.leafAnim.control = "start" ' Sampled in the SAME message-loop turn as the write: if the engine only applies ' keyValue[0] on the next frame, rectA.opacity is still its authored 0.0 here even ' though keyValue[0] is also 0.0 - so the interpolator starts at 0.25 on rectD (case D) ' to make that distinction visible. Here we only record that start was accepted. p("L-leaf", "immediately-after-start", snapshot(m.leafAnim, "leafAnim")) else if id = "L_mid" p("L-leaf", "mid-run", snapshot(m.leafAnim, "leafAnim")) else if id = "L_afterStop" p("L-leaf", "after-complete", snapshot(m.leafAnim, "leafAnim")) resetTargets()
else if id = "N_start" resetTargets() m.leafAnim.control = "start" p("N-none", "started", snapshot(m.leafAnim, "leafAnim")) else if id = "N_writeNone" p("N-none", "before-none", snapshot(m.leafAnim, "leafAnim")) m.leafAnim.control = "none" p("N-none", "immediately-after-none", snapshot(m.leafAnim, "leafAnim")) else if id = "N_sample" ' If `none` was inert, the animation kept running and opacity advanced further. ' If `none` stopped it, opacity is frozen at the before-none value. p("N-none", "settled", snapshot(m.leafAnim, "leafAnim")) else if id = "N_cleanup" m.leafAnim.control = "stop" resetTargets()
else if id = "PF_start" resetTargets() m.parAnim.control = "start" p("PF-par-finish", "started", parSnapshot()) else if id = "PF_finish" p("PF-par-finish", "before-finish", parSnapshot()) m.parAnim.control = "finish" p("PF-par-finish", "immediately-after-finish", parSnapshot()) else if id = "PF_sample" ' THE headline case: per the reference both targets must read 1.0 here. p("PF-par-finish", "settled", parSnapshot()) else if id = "PF_cleanup" m.parAnim.control = "stop" resetTargets()
else if id = "PP_start" resetTargets() m.parAnim.control = "start" p("PP-par-pause", "started", parSnapshot()) else if id = "PP_pause" m.parAnim.control = "pause" p("PP-par-pause", "immediately-after-pause", parSnapshot()) else if id = "PP_sampleA" p("PP-par-pause", "just-after-pause", parSnapshot()) else if id = "PP_sampleB" ' If the children ignored the pause they kept advancing between sampleA and sampleB. p("PP-par-pause", "one-second-later", parSnapshot()) else if id = "PP_resume" m.parAnim.control = "resume" p("PP-par-pause", "immediately-after-resume", parSnapshot()) else if id = "PP_sampleC" ' Continue from where it paused, or restart from 0? p("PP-par-pause", "after-resume", parSnapshot()) else if id = "PP_cleanup" p("PP-par-pause", "settled", parSnapshot()) m.parAnim.control = "stop" resetTargets()
else if id = "SF_start" resetTargets() m.seqAnim.control = "start" p("SF-seq-finish", "started", seqSnapshot()) else if id = "SF_finish" p("SF-seq-finish", "before-finish", seqSnapshot()) m.seqAnim.control = "finish" p("SF-seq-finish", "immediately-after-finish", seqSnapshot()) else if id = "SF_sample" ' Per the reference all three targets must read 1.0, including children 2 and 3 ' which never got to run. p("SF-seq-finish", "settled", seqSnapshot()) else if id = "SF_cleanup" m.seqAnim.control = "stop" resetTargets()
else if id = "SP_start" resetTargets() m.seqAnim.control = "start" p("SP-seq-pause", "started", seqSnapshot()) else if id = "SP_pause" m.seqAnim.control = "pause" p("SP-seq-pause", "immediately-after-pause", seqSnapshot()) else if id = "SP_sample" ' If the sequence ignored pause it has advanced into child 2 by now. p("SP-seq-pause", "one-second-later", seqSnapshot()) else if id = "SP_resume" m.seqAnim.control = "resume" p("SP-seq-pause", "immediately-after-resume", seqSnapshot()) else if id = "SP_sampleAfter" p("SP-seq-pause", "after-resume", seqSnapshot()) else if id = "SP_cleanup" m.seqAnim.control = "stop" resetTargets()
else if id = "D_start" resetTargets() p("D-delay", "before-start", "rectD.opacity=" + f(m.rectD.opacity) + " state=" + m.delayAnim.state) m.delayAnim.control = "start" ' keyValue[0] is 0.25 and the authored opacity is 0.0, so these are distinguishable: ' 0.25 means the target was snapped at start, 0.0 means it was not. p("D-delay", "immediately-after-start", "rectD.opacity=" + f(m.rectD.opacity) + " state=" + m.delayAnim.state) else if id = "D_duringDelay" p("D-delay", "during-delay", "rectD.opacity=" + f(m.rectD.opacity) + " state=" + m.delayAnim.state) else if id = "D_afterDelay" p("D-delay", "after-delay", "rectD.opacity=" + f(m.rectD.opacity) + " state=" + m.delayAnim.state) else if id = "D_cleanup" m.delayAnim.control = "stop" resetTargets()
else if id = "FINISH" p("all", "done", "") m.stepTimer.control = "stop" m.top.probeExit = true end if end sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Snapshots '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function snapshot(anim as object, label as string) as string return label + ".state=" + anim.state + " rectA.opacity=" + f(m.rectA.opacity) end function
function parSnapshot() as string out = "par.state=" + m.parAnim.state out = out + " c1.state=" + m.parChild1.state out = out + " c2.state=" + m.parChild2.state out = out + " rectA.opacity=" + f(m.rectA.opacity) out = out + " rectB.opacity=" + f(m.rectB.opacity) return out end function
function seqSnapshot() as string out = "seq.state=" + m.seqAnim.state out = out + " c1.state=" + m.seqChild1.state out = out + " c2.state=" + m.seqChild2.state out = out + " c3.state=" + m.seqChild3.state out = out + " rectA.opacity=" + f(m.rectA.opacity) out = out + " rectB.opacity=" + f(m.rectB.opacity) out = out + " rectC.opacity=" + f(m.rectC.opacity) return out end function
sub resetTargets() m.rectA.opacity = 0.0 m.rectB.opacity = 0.0 m.rectC.opacity = 0.0 m.rectD.opacity = 0.0 end sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Helpers '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Two decimals, so a sample is stable across device/engine frame-timing jitter while still ' distinguishing "reached the final value" from "stopped partway". function f(v as dynamic) as string if v = invalid then return "<invalid>" n = int(v * 100 + 0.5) whole = int(n / 100) frac = n - whole * 100 fs = itos(frac) if fs.len() < 2 then fs = "0" + fs return itos(whole) + "." + fs end function
function itos(i as integer) as string return str(i).trim() end function
sub p(phase as string, caseId as string, detail as string) m.seq = m.seq + 1 s = itos(m.seq) while s.len() < 3 s = "0" + s end while print "PROBE|" + s + "|" + phase + "|" + caseId + "|" + detail end sub
